eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 9:55 PM on AUG 25, 2022 Effective until 7:55 AM AUG 26, 2022. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Phoenix Police Department is looking for 23 year old Vicente Joseph Russell. He is a Hispanic male, 6 feet tall, weighing 160 pounds with brown hair and brown eyes. Vicente was last seen wearing a blue t-shirt, black shorts, and no shoes. He was last seen on 08/25/2022 at 5 PM in the area of North 34th Avenue and West Moreland Street in Phoenix. Vicente is non-verbal and suffers from Autism. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
